title: Mirai Botnet Investigation and Mitigation
description: Investigate and mitigate a Mirai botnet infection targeting Realtek and Huawei routers. The botnet is using the Linux/Mirai-Hilix variant, which exploits default passwords to gain access to devices and performs lateral movement, exfiltration, and maintains persistence.
outcomes: Identify and investigate suspicious beacon and flood services.
Contain and block C2 communication and flooding activities.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: You are part of an incident response team tasked with investigating and mitigating a Mirai botnet infection. The botnet is using the Linux/Mirai-Hilix variant, which targets Realtek and Huawei routers. The malware performs lateral movement, exfiltration, and maintains persistence through various mechanisms.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the sandbox via the provided cloud environment.
levels.local_content: Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario.

levels.title: Identify and investigate suspicious beacon service
levels.content: Investigate the suspicious beacon service running on bot1. The service is communicating with a command-and-control (C2) server. Identify the service name and provide it as the flag.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services running on the host. The service name is bot-beacon-Hilix.sh.service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services running on the host.

levels.title: Identify and investigate suspicious flood service
levels.content: Investigate the suspicious flood service running on bot1. The service is performing flooding attacks. Identify the service name and provide it as the flag.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services running on the host. The service name is bot-flood-Hilix.sh.service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services running on the host.

levels.title: Contain and block C2 communication
levels.content: Contain and block the C2 communication by stopping the beacon service on bot1. Identify the port number used for C2 communication and provide it as the flag.
levels.solution: Check the beacon service configuration. The port number used for C2 communication is 2222.
